name: domain.wiki_compiler
description: Compiler-style dual in-memory / disk wiki builder with topological graph queries, incremental dirty-diff writing, and notes preservation

entrypoints.name: compile_wiki_directory
entrypoints.description: Compile an entire raw notes directory into a cross-referenced Markdown wiki preserving notes

parameters.name: raw_dir
parameters.description: Path to directory containing raw notes (.txt or .md)

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Destination path for compiled wiki pages

parameters.name: run_linter
parameters.description: Whether to run post-compilation link and orphan linter

entrypoints.name: compile_virtual_wiki
entrypoints.description: Compile in-memory notes into a cross-referenced Markdown wiki without disk I/O

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Dictionary of note identifier to raw note text content

parameters.name: preserve_sections
parameters.description: Optional map of existing page markdown text to preserve ## Notes sections

entrypoints.name: query_wiki_graph
entrypoints.description: Perform topological graph queries over the wiki mention network (neighborhood, backlinks, path, clusters)

parameters.name: raw_dir
parameters.description: Optional path to directory containing raw notes

parameters.name: root_entity
parameters.description: Target entity ID for neighborhood/backlinks/path source

parameters.name: target_entity
parameters.description: Target entity ID for path queries

parameters.name: max_hops
parameters.description: Maximum search distance for neighborhood queries (default: 2)

entrypoints.name: compile_wiki_incremental
entrypoints.description: Compile wiki pages only writing changed markdown files to disk (dirty-tracking diff writer)

parameters.name: raw_dir
parameters.description: Path to directory containing raw notes

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Destination path for compiled wiki pages

entrypoints.name: extract_entity_metadata
entrypoints.description: Extract metadata, name, and aliases from a single note file

entrypoints.name: build_reference_graph
entrypoints.description: Extract all entities and compute the full directional cross-reference graph

parameters.name: raw_dir
parameters.description: Path to directory containing raw notes

entrypoints.name: lint_wiki
entrypoints.description: Lint compiled wiki directory for broken [[wikilinks]] and unreferenced orphan pages

parameters.name: compiled_dir
parameters.description: Path to directory containing compiled .md pages

entrypoints.name: generate_synthetic_notes
entrypoints.description: Generate a synthetic corpus of raw notes with embedded cross-mentions for benchmarking

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Target directory to write synthetic .txt note files

parameters.name: num_files
parameters.description: Number of note files to generate (default: 20)
